```python
import csv
from pathlib import Path

path = Path('work/tutorial/team-blue.csv')
expected = [
    'team_id', 'site_id', 'bus_id', 'connection_capacity_mw',
    'generator_capacity_mw', 'storage_power_mw', 'storage_energy_mwh',
]
with path.open(newline='', encoding='utf-8') as handle:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(handle))
assert rows, 'fixture should contain at least one site row'
assert list(rows[0]) == expected
assert all('period' not in row and 'load_mw' not in row for row in rows)
assert len({row['site_id'] for row in rows}) == len(rows), 'one row per site'
print(f'small test inspected {len(rows)} site rows')
```
